title: MerlinOption
description: A static, searchable command registered with the Merlin (Super Daemon) singleton via `SuperDaemonInstance.defineOption(option)`. When the user selects the row, a CustomEvent named `eventName` is dispatched with `detail` set to `value`. The `value` object's shape is governed by which `eventName` is used (see merlin-program.schema.json for the program variant, and the README event-contract table for the element-method / element-click / disabled variants).

title.description: Primary display label shown in the result row. Used for alphabetical sort and exact-match priority boosting. Required.

value.description: Payload dispatched as the `detail` of the CustomEvent named by `eventName`. Shape varies by eventName: {target, method, args?} for super-daemon-element-method; {target} for super-daemon-element-click; {name, program, machineName?, placeholder?, initialValue?, context?} for super-daemon-run-program; {disabled: true} for disabled. Required.

eventName.description: Name of the CustomEvent dispatched when the row is selected. Known values: super-daemon-element-method, super-daemon-element-click, super-daemon-run-program, disabled. Required.

icon.description: Icon name (e.g. 'icons:save', 'hax:wizard-hat') rendered by simple-icon-lite in the row.

image.description: Image URL rendered in the row as an alternative to icon.

textCharacter.description: A single character or emoji rendered in the row as an alternative to icon/image (e.g. '🍌', '🎅').

tags.description: Searchable keyword tags. Also rendered as simple-tag chips in the row. Defaults to [] if omitted.

path.description: Breadcrumb-style location string (e.g. 'CMS/admin/seo', '>settings/platformAudience'). Searchable as a whole phrase and split on '/'. Defaults to '' if omitted.

priority.description: Sort weight. Lower numbers sort higher (appear nearer the top). Negative values boost prominence; an exact title match forces -10000000. Defaults to 0.

context.description: Visibility scope. A single string or an array of strings. '*' (the default) means the option is available in every context. Other common values: 'CMS', 'HAX', 'admin', 'logged-in', '>' (developer mode). An option only appears when the active commandContext intersects its context list.

voice.description: Voice-command phrase pattern for the hal-9000 speech layer, e.g. '(toggle) dark mode'. Parenthesized segments are optional words. Falls back to `title` when omitted.

more.description: Extra detail rendered in an expandable details section of the row. In the runtime this is a lit-html TemplateResult, so it is not JSON-typed here; treat as freeform renderable content.

inline.description: When true, the option is eligible to appear in inline (mini) mode. Defaults to false.

hidden.description: When true, the option is registered and invokable by machineName/shortcut but excluded from browse/search results. Used for dedicated-shortcut-only commands (e.g. emoji/symbol pickers).

index.description: AUTO-BUILT by defineOption() — do not set this yourself. A space-joined, de-duplicated, lowercased search index derived from tags/path/title/voice/more/context plus the full path phrase.
